dct_description_sm: As part of a larger project to understand the determinants of beaver abundance and distriution across the province of Qubec, aerial beaver surveys on the northeastern and northwestern coasts of Qubec were performed to (a) establish the present day range limit of beavers in northern Qubec, (b) quantify present-day beaver abundance in the vicinity of these range limits, and (c) evaluate habitat selection by beavers near the edge of their northern Qubec range.
dct_title_s: Aerial surveys of beaver abundance in Lac Guillaume-Delisle and Lac  L'Eau Claire watersheds, Hudson Bay, Quebec
